mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_FOLLOW (FOLLOWER_ID, FOLLOWING_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followingId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWER_ID = #{followerId} AND FOLLOWING_ID = #{followingId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWER_ID = #{followerId} AND FOLLOWING_ID = #{followingId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FOLLOW A JOIN USER_FOLLOW B ON A.FOLLOWER_ID = B.FOLLOWING_ID AND A.FOLLOWING_ID = B.FOLLOWER_ID WHERE A.FOLLOWER_ID = #{followerId} AND A.FOLLOWING_ID = #{followingId}

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FOLLOW F2 WHERE F2.FOLLOWER_ID = #{userId} AND F2.FOLLOWING_ID = U.USER_ID) AS isFollowingBack FROM USER_FOLLOW F JOIN USER U ON F.FOLLOWER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE F.FOLLOWING_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT U.USER_ID AS userId, U.USER_NAME AS userName, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS profileImg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FOLLOW F2 WHERE F2.FOLLOWER_ID = U.USER_ID AND F2.FOLLOWING_ID = #{userId}) AS isFollowingMe FROM USER_FOLLOW F JOIN USER U ON F.FOLLOWING_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE F.FOLLOWER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC
